metal_kernel(name: str, input_names: collections.abc.Sequence[str], output_names: collections.abc.Sequence[str], source: str, header: str = '', ensure_row_contiguous: bool = True, atomic_outputs: bool = False, compile_options: object | None = None) -> object

      A jit-compiled custom Metal kernel defined from a source string.

      Full documentation: :ref:`custom_metal_kernels`.

      Args:
        name (str): Name for the kernel.
        input_names (List[str]): The parameter names of the inputs in the
           function signature.
        output_names (List[str]): The parameter names of the outputs in the
           function signature.
        source (str): Source code. This is the body of a function in Metal,
           the function signature will be automatically generated.
        header (str): Header source code to include before the main function.
           Useful for helper functions or includes that should live outside of
           the main function body.
        ensure_row_contiguous (bool): Whether to ensure the inputs are row contiguous
           before the kernel runs. Default: ``True``.
        atomic_outputs (bool): Whether to use atomic outputs in the function signature
           e.g. ``device atomic<float>``. Default: ``False``.
        compile_options (dict, optional): Options to compile the Metal kernel
           with. Supported options:

           * ``"math_mode"``: The Metal math mode: ``"safe"``, ``"relaxed"``,
             or ``"fast"``. ``"safe"`` preserves IEEE behavior for special
             values such as ``exp(-inf) == 0``. Default: ``"safe"``.

      Returns:
        Callable ``metal_kernel``.

      Example:

        .. code-block:: python

          def exp_elementwise(a: mx.array):
              source = '''
                  uint elem = thread_position_in_grid.x;
                  T tmp = inp[elem];
                  out[elem] = metal::exp(tmp);
              '''

              kernel = mx.fast.metal_kernel(
                  name="myexp",
                  input_names=["inp"],
                  output_names=["out"],
                  source=source
              )
              outputs = kernel(
                  inputs=[a],
                  template=[("T", mx.float32)],
                  grid=(a.size, 1, 1),
                  threadgroup=(256, 1, 1),
                  output_shapes=[a.shape],
                  output_dtypes=[a.dtype],
                  verbose=True,
              )
              return outputs[0]

          a = mx.random.normal(shape=(4, 16)).astype(mx.float16)
          b = exp_elementwise(a)
          assert mx.allclose(b, mx.exp(a))
     
rope(a: array, dims: int, *, traditional: bool, base: float | None, scale: float, offset: int | array, freqs: array | None = None, stream: StreamOrDevice = None) -> array

        Apply rotary positional encoding to the input.

        The input is expected to be at least 3D with shape ``(B, *, T, D)`` where:
          * ``B`` is the batch size.
          * ``T`` is the sequence length.
          * ``D`` is the feature dimension.

        Args:
            a (array): The input array.
            dims (int): The feature dimensions to be rotated. If the input feature
              is larger than dims then the rest is left unchanged.
            traditional (bool): If set to ``True`` choose the traditional
              implementation which rotates consecutive dimensions.
            base (float, optional): The base used to compute angular frequency for
              each dimension in the positional encodings. Exactly one of ``base`` and
              ``freqs`` must be ``None``.
            scale (float): The scale used to scale the positions.
            offset (int or array): The position offset to start at. If an
              :obj:`array` is given it can be a scalar or vector of ``B``
              offsets for each example in the batch.
            freqs (array, optional): Optional frequencies to use with RoPE.
              If set, the ``base`` parameter must be ``None``. Default: ``None``.

        Returns:
            array: The output array.

def generate_step(
    prompt: mx.array,
    model: nn.Module,
    *,
    max_tokens: int = 256,
    sampler: Optional[Callable[[mx.array], mx.array]] = None,
    logits_processors: Optional[List[Callable[[mx.array, mx.array], mx.array]]] = None,
    max_kv_size: Optional[int] = None,
    prompt_cache: Optional[Any] = None,
    prefill_step_size: int = 2048,
    kv_bits: Optional[int] = None,
    kv_group_size: int = 64,
    quantized_kv_start: int = 0,
    prompt_progress_callback: Optional[Callable[[int, int], None]] = None,
    input_embeddings: Optional[mx.array] = None,
) -> Generator[Tuple[mx.array, mx.array], None, None]:
    """
    A generator producing token ids based on the given prompt from the model.

    Args:
        prompt (mx.array): The input prompt.
        model (nn.Module): The model to use for generation.
        max_tokens (int): The maximum number of tokens. Use``-1`` for an infinite
          generator. Default: ``256``.
        sampler (Callable[mx.array, mx.array], optional): A sampler for sampling a
          token from a vector of log probabilities. Default: ``None``.
        logits_processors (List[Callable[[mx.array, mx.array], mx.array]], optional):
          A list of functions that take tokens and logits and return the processed
          logits. Default: ``None``.
        max_kv_size (int, optional): Maximum size of the key-value cache. Old
          entries (except the first 4 tokens) will be overwritten.
        prompt_cache (List[Any], optional): A pre-computed prompt cache. Note, if
          provided, the cache will be updated in place.
        prefill_step_size (int): Step size for processing the prompt.
        kv_bits (int, optional): Number of bits to use for KV cache quantization.
          None implies no cache quantization. Default: ``None``.
        kv_group_size (int): Group size for KV cache quantization. Default: ``64``.
        quantized_kv_start (int): Step to begin using a quantized KV cache.
           when ``kv_bits`` is non-None. Default: ``0``.
        prompt_progress_callback (Callable[[int, int], None]): A call-back which takes the
           prompt tokens processed so far and the total number of prompt tokens.
        input_embeddings (mx.array, optional): Input embeddings to use instead of or in
          conjunction with prompt tokens. Default: ``None``.

    Yields:
        Tuple[mx.array, mx.array]: One token and a vector of log probabilities.
    """
    if input_embeddings is not None:
        if not does_model_support_input_embeddings(model):
            raise ValueError("Model does not support input embeddings.")
        elif len(prompt) > 0 and len(prompt) != len(input_embeddings):
            raise ValueError(
                f"When providing input_embeddings, their sequence length ({len(input_embeddings)}) "
                f"must match the sequence length of the prompt ({len(prompt)}), or the "
                "prompt must be empty."
            )
    elif len(prompt) == 0:
        raise ValueError(
            "Either input_embeddings or prompt (or both) must be provided."
        )

    tokens = None

    # Create the KV cache for generation
    if prompt_cache is None:
        prompt_cache = cache.make_prompt_cache(
            model,
            max_kv_size=max_kv_size,
        )

    prompt_progress_callback = prompt_progress_callback or (lambda *_: None)

    quantize_cache_fn = functools.partial(
        maybe_quantize_kv_cache,
        quantized_kv_start=quantized_kv_start,
        kv_group_size=kv_group_size,
        kv_bits=kv_bits,
    )

    sampler = sampler or (lambda x: mx.argmax(x, axis=-1))

    def _model_call(input_tokens: mx.array, input_embeddings: Optional[mx.array]):
        if input_embeddings is not None:
            return model(
                input_tokens, cache=prompt_cache, input_embeddings=input_embeddings
            )
        else:
            return model(input_tokens, cache=prompt_cache)

        nonlocal tokens

        with mx.stream(generation_stream):
            logits = _model_call(
                input_tokens=input_tokens[None],
                input_embeddings=(
                    input_embeddings[None] if input_embeddings is not None else None
                ),
            )

            logits = logits[:, -1, :]

            if logits_processors and len(input_tokens) > 0:
                tokens = (
                    mx.concat([tokens, input_tokens])
                    if tokens is not None
                    else input_tokens
                )
                for processor in logits_processors:
                    logits = processor(tokens, logits)

            quantize_cache_fn(prompt_cache)

            logprobs = logits - mx.logsumexp(logits, keepdims=True)
            sampled = sampler(logprobs)
            return sampled, logprobs.squeeze(0)

        total_prompt_tokens = (
            len(input_embeddings) if input_embeddings is not None else len(prompt)
        )
        prompt_processed_tokens = 0
        prompt_progress_callback(prompt_processed_tokens, total_prompt_tokens)
        while total_prompt_tokens - prompt_processed_tokens > 1:
            remaining = (total_prompt_tokens - prompt_processed_tokens) - 1
            n_to_process = min(prefill_step_size, remaining)
            _model_call(
                input_tokens=prompt[:n_to_process][None],
                input_embeddings=(
                    input_embeddings[:n_to_process][None]
                    if input_embeddings is not None
                    else None
                ),
            )
            quantize_cache_fn(prompt_cache)
            mx.eval([c.state for c in prompt_cache])
            prompt_processed_tokens += n_to_process
            prompt_progress_callback(prompt_processed_tokens, total_prompt_tokens)
            prompt = prompt[n_to_process:]
            input_embeddings = (
                input_embeddings[n_to_process:]
                if input_embeddings is not None
                else input_embeddings
            )
            mx.clear_cache()

        y, logprobs = _step(input_tokens=prompt, input_embeddings=input_embeddings)

    mx.async_eval(y, logprobs)
    n = 0
    while True:
        if n != max_tokens:
            next_y, next_logprobs = _step(y)
            mx.async_eval(next_y, next_logprobs)
        if n == 0:
            mx.eval(y)
            prompt_progress_callback(total_prompt_tokens, total_prompt_tokens)
        if n == max_tokens:
            break
        yield y.item(), logprobs
        if n % 256 == 0:
            mx.clear_cache()
        y, logprobs = next_y, next_logprobs
        n += 1

          A list of functions that take tokens and logits and return the processed
          logits. Default: ``None``.
        max_kv_size (int, optional): Maximum size of the key-value cache. Old
          entries (except the first 4 tokens) will be overwritten.
        prompt_cache (List[Any], optional): A pre-computed prompt cache. Note, if
          provided, the cache will be updated in place.
        prefill_step_size (int): Step size for processing the prompt.
        kv_bits (int, optional): Number of bits to use for KV cache quantization.
          None implies no cache quantization. Default: ``None``.
        kv_group_size (int): Group size for KV cache quantization. Default: ``64``.
        quantized_kv_start (int): Step to begin using a quantized KV cache.
           when ``kv_bits`` is non-None. Default: ``0``.
        prompt_progress_callback (Callable[[int, int], None]): A call-back which takes the
           prompt tokens processed so far and the total number of prompt tokens.
        input_embeddings (mx.array, optional): Input embeddings to use instead of or in
          conjunction with prompt tokens. Default: ``None``.

    Yields:
        Tuple[mx.array, mx.array]: One token and a vector of log probabilities.

        if not does_model_support_input_embeddings(model):
            raise ValueError("Model does not support input embeddings.")
        elif len(prompt) > 0 and len(prompt) != len(input_embeddings):
            raise ValueError(
                f"When providing input_embeddings, their sequence length ({len(input_embeddings)}) "
                f"must match the sequence length of the prompt ({len(prompt)}), or the "
                "prompt must be empty."
            )
    elif len(prompt) == 0:
        raise ValueError(
            "Either input_embeddings or prompt (or both) must be provided."
        )

    tokens = None

    # Create the KV cache for generation
    if prompt_cache is None:
        prompt_cache = cache.make_prompt_cache(
            model,
            max_kv_size=max_kv_size,
        )

    prompt_progress_callback = prompt_progress_callback or (lambda *_: None)

    quantize_cache_fn = functools.partial(
        maybe_quantize_kv_cache,
        quantized_kv_start=quantized_kv_start,
        kv_group_size=kv_group_size,
        kv_bits=kv_bits,
    )

    sampler = sampler or (lambda x: mx.argmax(x, axis=-1))

    def _model_call(input_tokens: mx.array, input_embeddings: Optional[mx.array]):
        if input_embeddings is not None:
            return model(
                input_tokens, cache=prompt_cache, input_embeddings=input_embeddings
            )
        else:
            return model(input_tokens, cache=prompt_cache)

    def _step(input_tokens: mx.array, input_embeddings: Optional[mx.array] = None):
        nonlocal tokens

        with mx.stream(generation_stream):
            logits = _model_call(
                input_tokens=input_tokens[None],
                input_embeddings=(
                    input_embeddings[None] if input_embeddings is not None else None
                ),
            )

            logits = logits[:, -1, :]

            if logits_processors and len(input_tokens) > 0:
                tokens = (
                    mx.concat([tokens, input_tokens])
                    if tokens is not None
                    else input_tokens
                )
                for processor in logits_processors:
                    logits = processor(tokens, logits)

            quantize_cache_fn(prompt_cache)

            logprobs = logits - mx.logsumexp(logits, keepdims=True)
            sampled = sampler(logprobs)
            return sampled, logprobs.squeeze(0)

    with mx.stream(generation_stream):
        total_prompt_tokens = (
            len(input_embeddings) if input_embeddings is not None else len(prompt)
        )
        prompt_processed_tokens = 0
        prompt_progress_callback(prompt_processed_tokens, total_prompt_tokens)
        while total_prompt_tokens - prompt_processed_tokens > 1:
            remaining = (total_prompt_tokens - prompt_processed_tokens) - 1
            n_to_process = min(prefill_step_size, remaining)
            _model_call(
                input_tokens=prompt[:n_to_process][None],
                input_embeddings=(
                    input_embeddings[:n_to_process][None]
                    if input_embeddings is not None
                    else None
                ),
            )
            quantize_cache_fn(prompt_cache)
            mx.eval([c.state for c in prompt_cache])
            prompt_processed_tokens += n_to_process
            prompt_progress_callback(prompt_processed_tokens, total_prompt_tokens)
            prompt = prompt[n_to_process:]
            input_embeddings = (
                input_embeddings[n_to_process:]
                if input_embeddings is not None
                else input_embeddings
            )
            mx.clear_cache()

        y, logprobs = _step(input_tokens=prompt, input_embeddings=input_embeddings)

    mx.async_eval(y, logprobs)
    n = 0
    while True:
        if n != max_tokens:
            next_y, next_logprobs = _step(y)
            mx.async_eval(next_y, next_logprobs)
        if n == 0:
            mx.eval(y)
            prompt_progress_callback(total_prompt_tokens, total_prompt_tokens)
        if n == max_tokens:
            break
        yield y.item(), logprobs
        if n % 256 == 0:
            mx.clear_cache()
        y, logprobs = next_y, next_logprobs
        n += 1

        Update a sub-array of the input array.

        Args:
          a (array): The input array to update
          update (array): The update array.
          start_indices (array): The index location to start the slice at.
          axes (tuple(int)): The axes corresponding to the indices in ``start_indices``.

        Returns:
          array: The output array with the same shape and type as the input.

        Example:

          >>> a = mx.zeros((3, 3))
          >>> mx.slice_update(a, mx.ones((1, 2)), start_indices=mx.array(1, 1), axes=(0, 1))
          array([[0, 0, 0],

rms_norm(x: array, weight: array | None, eps: float, *, stream: StreamOrDevice = None) -> array

        Root Mean Square normalization (RMS norm).

        The normalization is with respect to the last axis of the input ``x``.

        Args:
            x (array): Input array.
            weight (array, optional): A multiplicative weight to scale the result by.
              The ``weight`` should be one-dimensional with the same size
              as the last axis of ``x``. If set to ``None`` then no scaling happens.
            eps (float): A small additive constant for numerical stability.

        Returns:
            array: The output array.

import mlx.core as mx
from mlx_lm.models.activations import swiglu


def make_functions(args):
    nh, nk, d = args.num_attention_heads, args.num_key_value_heads, args.head_dim
    eps = args.rms_norm_eps

    @mx.compile
    def project(h, wnorm, wqkv, wqn, wkn, offset):
        b, length, _ = h.shape
        x = mx.fast.rms_norm(h, wnorm, eps)
        q, k, v = mx.split(x @ wqkv.T, [nh*d, (nh+nk)*d], axis=-1)
        q = mx.fast.rms_norm(q.reshape(b, length, nh, d), wqn, eps).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
        k = mx.fast.rms_norm(k.reshape(b, length, nk, d), wkn, eps).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
        v = v.reshape(b, length, nk, d).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
        q = mx.fast.rope(q, d, traditional=False, base=args.rope_theta, scale=1.0, offset=offset)
        k = mx.fast.rope(k, d, traditional=False, base=args.rope_theta, scale=1.0, offset=offset)
        return q, k, v

    @mx.compile
    def finish(h, o, wo, wn, wgu, wd):
        h = h + o @ wo.T
        x = mx.fast.rms_norm(h, wn, eps)
        gate, up = mx.split(x @ wgu.T, 2, axis=-1)
        return h + swiglu(gate, up) @ wd.T

    return project, finish

import sys, importlib.util, time, statistics
from pathlib import Path
import mlx.core as mx
from mlx_lm import load
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'engine'))
from engine import Engine

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('previous', sys.argv[1])
previous = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(previous)
model, _ = load('Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B')
engines = {'old': previous.Engine(model), 'new': Engine(model)}
for length in map(int, sys.argv[2:] or [16, 256, 1024, 4096]):
    prompt = mx.random.randint(1000, 150000, (length,), key=mx.random.key(123)).tolist()
    rows = {'old': [], 'new': []}
    for rep in range(6):
        for name in (['old', 'new'] if rep % 2 == 0 else ['new', 'old']):
            engine = engines[name]
            mx.synchronize(engine.stream)
            start = time.perf_counter()
            stamps = []
            for token in engine.generate(prompt, 32):
                stamps.append(time.perf_counter()-start)
            mx.synchronize(engine.stream)
            if rep:
                rows[name].append((stamps[0]*1000, statistics.median([b-a for a,b in zip(stamps[3:], stamps[4:])])*1000))
    vals = {k: [statistics.median(r[i] for r in rs) for i in range(2)] for k,rs in rows.items()}
    print(length, vals, 'ratios', [vals['old'][i]/vals['new'][i] for i in range(2)], flush=True)

class RMSNorm(Module):
    r"""Applies Root Mean Square normalization [1] to the inputs.

    Computes

    ..  math::

        y = \frac{x}{\sqrt{E[x^2] + \epsilon}} \gamma

    where :math:`\gamma` is a learned per feature dimension parameter initialized at
    1.

    Note the accumulation for the mean is done in 32-bit precision.

    [1]: https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.07467

    Args:
        dims (int): The feature dimension of the input to normalize over
        eps (float): A small additive constant for numerical stability.
            Default: ``1e-5``.
    """

    def __init__(self, dims: int, eps: float = 1e-5):
        super().__init__()
        self.weight = mx.ones((dims,))
        self.eps = eps

    def _extra_repr(self):
        return f"{self.weight.shape[0]}, eps={self.eps}"

    def __call__(self, x):
        return mx.fast.rms_norm(x, self["weight"], self.eps)

import sys,time,random,statistics
from pathlib import Path
import mlx.core as mx
from mlx_lm import load
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'engine'))
from engine import Engine
model,_=load('Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B');eng=Engine(model)
for length in map(int,sys.argv[1:] or [4096,9000,32768]):
    prompt=mx.random.randint(1000,150000,(length,),key=mx.random.key(100)).tolist()
    results={c:[] for c in [1024,2048,4096,8192]}
    for rep in range(2):
        chunks=list(results);random.Random(rep).shuffle(chunks)
        for chunk in chunks:
            mx.synchronize(eng.stream)
            start=time.perf_counter()
            tokens=list(eng.generate(prompt,2,prefill_step_size=chunk))
            mx.synchronize(eng.stream)
            elapsed=time.perf_counter()-start
            results[chunk].append(elapsed)
            print(length,chunk,rep,elapsed,tokens,flush=True)
            time.sleep(10)
    print('SUMMARY',length,{c:statistics.median(ts) for c,ts in results.items()},flush=True)

"""Qwen3 BF16 single-stream inference engine (starting point).

Own transformer forward and greedy generation loop on MLX, using mlx-lm only for
weights, RoPE and the KV cache. Behaves like mlx-lm's default generate path.

API contract (checked by tools/check.py; the final evaluation uses exactly this):

    engine = Engine(model)              # model from mlx_lm.load(...)
    engine.stream                       # the mx.Stream all engine GPU work runs on
    cache = engine.new_cache(capacity)  # capacity = max tokens the request will hold
    logits = engine.forward(tokens, cache)   # tokens: mx.array [1, n] int; returns logits of the
                                             # LAST position, shape [vocab]; advances the cache by n
    for tok in engine.generate(prompt, max_tokens):   # greedy; yields exactly max_tokens ints; ignores EOS
        ...
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterator

import mlx.core as mx
from mlx_lm.generate import generation_stream
from mlx_lm.models.activations import swiglu
from mlx_lm.models.base import create_attention_mask
from mlx_lm.models.cache import KVCache
try:
    from .norm_rope import norm_rope
except ImportError:
    from norm_rope import norm_rope


class Engine:
    def __init__(self, model):
        if model.model_type != "qwen3":
            raise ValueError("Only dense Qwen3 is supported")
        self.model = model
        self.args = model.args
        self.stream = generation_stream
        self.qkv = [mx.concatenate([l.self_attn.q_proj.weight,
                                    l.self_attn.k_proj.weight,
                                    l.self_attn.v_proj.weight]) for l in model.layers]
        self.gu = [mx.concatenate([l.mlp.gate_proj.weight, l.mlp.up_proj.weight])
                   for l in model.layers]
        mx.eval(self.qkv, self.gu)

    def new_cache(self, capacity: int | None = None):
        return [KVCache() for _ in self.model.layers]

    def _hidden(self, tokens, cache, last_only=False):
        h = self.model.model.embed_tokens(tokens)
        mask = create_attention_mask(h, cache[0])
        B, L, _ = h.shape
        offset = mx.array(cache[0].offset, dtype=mx.int32)
        for i, (layer, c) in enumerate(zip(self.model.layers, cache)):
            a, m = layer.self_attn, layer.mlp
            x = layer.input_layernorm(h)
            qsize = a.n_heads * self.args.head_dim
            kvsize = a.n_kv_heads * self.args.head_dim
            final = i == len(self.model.layers) - 1
            if final and L > 1:
                kv = x @ self.qkv[i][qsize:].T
                k, v = mx.split(kv, 2, axis=-1)
                if last_only:
                    q = a.q_proj(x[:, -1:, :])
                    h = h[:, -1:, :]
                    qlength = 1
                else:
                    q = None
            else:
                qkv = x @ self.qkv[i].T
                if L <= 64:
                    q, k, v = norm_rope(qkv, a.q_norm.weight, a.k_norm.weight, offset, self.args)
                else:
                    q, k, v = mx.split(qkv, [qsize, qsize + kvsize], axis=-1)
                qlength = L
            fused = L <= 64 and not (final and L > 1)
            if q is not None and not fused:
                q = a.q_norm(q.reshape(B, qlength, a.n_heads, -1)).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
                q = a.rope(q, offset=c.offset + L - qlength)
            if not fused:
                k = a.k_norm(k.reshape(B, L, a.n_kv_heads, -1)).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
                v = v.reshape(B, L, a.n_kv_heads, -1).transpose(0, 2, 1, 3)
                k = a.rope(k, offset=c.offset)
            k, v = c.update_and_fetch(k, v)
            if q is None:
                return h
            o = mx.fast.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, scale=a.scale,
                                                   mask=None if qlength == 1 else mask)
            h = h + a.o_proj(o.transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(B, qlength, -1))
            x = layer.post_attention_layernorm(h)
            gate, up = mx.split(x @ self.gu[i].T, 2, axis=-1)
            h = h + m.down_proj(swiglu(gate, up))
        return self.model.model.norm(h[:, -1:, :] if last_only else h)

    def forward(self, tokens, cache):
        """Logits [vocab] of the last position; advances the cache."""
        with mx.stream(self.stream):
            h = self._hidden(tokens, cache, last_only=True)
            return self.model.model.embed_tokens.as_linear(h[:, -1:, :])[0, 0]

    def generate(self, prompt: list[int], max_tokens: int, prefill_step_size: int = 2048) -> Iterator[int]:
        if not prompt or max_tokens < 0:
            raise ValueError("Nonempty prompt and nonnegative max_tokens required")
        if max_tokens == 0:
            return
        cache = self.new_cache(len(prompt) + max_tokens)
        with mx.stream(self.stream):
            rest = prompt
            while len(rest) > prefill_step_size:
                n = prefill_step_size
                self._hidden(mx.array(rest[:n])[None], cache)
                mx.eval([c.state for c in cache])
                mx.clear_cache()
                rest = rest[n:]
            y = mx.argmax(self.forward(mx.array(rest)[None], cache))
            mx.async_eval(y)
            for i in range(max_tokens):
                if i + 1 < max_tokens:
                    nxt = mx.argmax(self.forward(y.reshape(1, 1), cache))
                    mx.async_eval(nxt)
                yield y.item()
                if i + 1 < max_tokens:
                    y = nxt

import sys,time,statistics
from pathlib import Path
import mlx.core as mx
from mlx_lm import load
from bounded_head import BoundedHead
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'engine'))
from engine import Engine
model,_=load('Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B');eng=Engine(model)
heads=[BoundedHead(model.model.embed_tokens.weight,prefix=p) for p in [512,768]]
prompt=mx.random.randint(1000,150000,(512,),key=mx.random.key(10000))[None]
cache=eng.new_cache(600)
with mx.stream(eng.stream):
    h=eng._hidden(prompt,cache,last_only=True);mx.eval(h)
    for step in range(4):
        stock=model.model.embed_tokens.as_linear(h)[0,0]
        tok=mx.argmax(stock);mx.eval(tok)
        print('step',step,'stock token',tok.item(),'range',mx.min(stock).item(),mx.max(stock).item(),flush=True)
        for head in heads:
            scores,p,xn,threshold=head.scores(h);mx.eval(scores,p,xn,threshold)
            got=mx.argmax(scores).item()
            print('prefix',head.prefix,'token',got,'active',mx.sum(mx.isfinite(scores)).item(),
                  'threshold',threshold.item(),'norms',xn.tolist(),
                  'max error of active scores',mx.max(mx.where(mx.isfinite(scores),mx.abs(scores-stock),0)).item(),flush=True)
            old=lambda:mx.argmax(model.model.embed_tokens.as_linear(h)[0,0])
            new=lambda:head(h)
            for name,fn in [('old',old),('new',new)]:
                ts=[]
                for _ in range(5):
                    mx.synchronize(eng.stream);s=time.perf_counter();mx.eval(fn());mx.synchronize(eng.stream);ts.append(time.perf_counter()-s)
                print(name,statistics.median(ts)*1000,flush=True)
        h=eng._hidden(tok.reshape(1,1),cache,last_only=True);mx.eval(h)
